mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where the level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the periods where FEDFUNDS is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over 3 months signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% year-over-year during a period of economic expansion signals a potential overheat in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST decreases by more than 5% YoY during an expansion.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals a shift towards service-oriented growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases & INDPRO decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.
